resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Central US Lookouts page files the tower under Miller County and places it on the Miller and Cole county line. Wikipedia's infobox lists the community of Eugene in Cole County. The story notes both and does not change the record.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: one compiled page and a plan from 1950 that is not confirmed as built. The 100-foot height is a planned figure, so it is not in facts. The page does not say where the tower went after the 1971-72 move, and no search found the new site or any current status. The record's coordinates (38.3746, -92.4068) sit about 2.4 km north of Wikipedia's Eugene point (38.35278, -92.40389). A later search for the tower name also turned up no lookout-tower record for Eugene. Ask MDC for the post-1972 site before drafting more.
